title: CFDE-DESIGN
bodyHtml:
CFDE-DESIGN: Turn mechanistic leads into experiments

Want to start validating your hypothesis, but unsure of where to start? CFDE-DESIGN is here to help. The CFDE-DESIGN workflow starts with a CFDE-driven hypothesis generated by CFDE-REVEAL or a phenotype-gene set association generated by the KC Gene Set Browser. It then uses artificial intelligence to generate experimental protocols tailored to answer your question. Optionally, you can specify more details about your model system, assay, or readout of choice to get a customized view.

Start by following the prompts below.
